decisions.reason: Restricting available theme-color choices does not change any font size, weight, family, italics, or caption typography requirement.
The palette restriction does not change the PBU prefix, Danish naming language, covered style categories, or naming applicability.
The new style system must still be applied consistently across all templates; restricting color choices does not alter that application requirement or its specification reference.

The source separately reports incorrect bullet sizes and spacing, but the palette decision itself does not change the required bullet dimensions, alignment, scaling, appearance, or green level-four variant.
Restricting theme-color choices has no effect on the calendar-style date selector or its template contexts.
The color-palette restriction does not change word wrapping or right-column overflow containment behavior.
The palette decision does not affect alignment between Item and Title and the other Board Meeting fields.
The palette restriction does not change line-insertion or horizontal-border behavior in Board Meeting rows.
Available theme colors are independent of hard-return spacing in continuous text.
The palette restriction does not change fixed-margin behavior or protection of the pencil icon.
Restricting color choices has no effect on multiline entry or manual line-break support.
The palette decision does not change field activation, placeholder clearing, or the required click-and-type workflow.
